title: Reading Simple Words
introduction: Learn about reading simple words through simple examples and practice.
definition: Join the sounds in short words to read them. For example, c-a-t makes cat.
rules: Say each sound slowly, then blend them together.

vocabulary.description: A small animal often kept as a pet.
The star that gives Earth light.

examples.question: Join c-a-t.
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.
